$description: Citation ledger: which real file/line backs each major decision in this design-repo. Degrades gracefully (warn, not fail) when no sibling source tree is present, per BUILD-GUIDE.md 2.7's entryPoints self-containment rule. Paths are relative to design-repo/'s own location, one level inside granola-clone/.

citations.claim: 8 real routes, client-side router with inert external links
Home page composition (11 components)
Chat page composition (2 sections)
Enterprise page composition (2 sections)
Pricing page composition (7 sections)
Blog page composition (1 section, filterable list shape)
BlogAppleWatch page composition (1 section, long-form article shape)
Jobs page composition (1 multi-zone section)
ContactSales page composition (1 section)
conversion.footer-cta gated per-route via App.jsx PAGES.cta boolean; home and enterprise are false
Homepage design tokens (color, typography, radius, elevation, easing, shared button contract)
Homepage section-by-section content and motion contracts (sections 1-14)
Asset inventory, identical/recompressed status, real customer/testimonial identities requiring licensing guidance
24 real motion implementation files ground the motion contracts
Blog is a filterable list shape (chip filter + grid, useBlogListFilter), distinct from BlogAppleWatch's long-form article shape
BlogAppleWatch is a long-form article shape (byline, date, share, prose body), distinct from Blog's filterable list
Jobs is one continuous multi-zone section (hero + openings-by-category + team proof)
ContactSales embeds a real third-party Tally form, a deliberate exception to the no-outbound-links router constraint
Enterprise's FAQ accordion directly imports and reuses Pricing's FaqAccordion.jsx component
src/layout.json is a stale first-draft artifact (missing Pricing section, mismatched component names) and was not used as a build source

note: Source paths above are relative to this design-repo's location inside granola-clone/ and only resolve when this folder sits next to its original source tree (as it does during the build). A standalone copy of design-repo/ will not find these files — extraction/verify_all.py's citation check treats a missing sibling source tree as a warning, not a failure.
